question: Can one externally offered AI trace be serialized across two GPU/RAN homes while every committed request is backed by the selected home local all-fail certificate and physical AI lease?
canary_outcome: PASS: 101 unique timely requests split 50/51, prepare/commit/complete exactly once, broker outstanding/duplicates 0, all RAN safety gates pass.
mode: two synchronized A100 homes, four cells/two local NRx/Qwen each, one global BurstGPT queue, global broker policy, local atomic recovery replan+AI lease, P180/D155, mixed faults
failure_rule: Before global commit, a local rejection aborts the hold. After global commit, timeout/crash leaves request and physical credit unavailable; no reassignment without recovery protocol.
gate_rule: Both arms must pass RAN safety and worker counts; share one release epoch; execute every AI request at most once; conserve timely value between broker and homes; serve both homes; show legal broker event sequences; end with zero broker tokens, duplicate commits, local leases, endpoint credits, and recovery credits; preserve source/artifact hashes.
claim_rule: A pass establishes finite-sample serializable global AI admission composed with local recovery certificates. It does not establish throughput superiority, distributed hardware atomicity, WCET, shared NRx endpoints, or production DU timing.
